title: Ennis House

terrainReference.basis: Flat western motor-court paving, visible in satellite context; avoids the sloping street outside the northwest gate.

note: Approximate full textile-block house, bridge-linked garage, courts and retaining terraces. Source QA records public-domain HABS and independent USGS bridge/ground observations. Bounded ground opening only under solid entrance paving; all original ground samples and whole-house transform retained.

groundCutout.basis: Only the authored sloping entrance paving beneath the bridge and its short street/court transitions. USGS B23 points show the bridge deck incorrectly represented as ground by the interpolated raster. Preserve every original height sample and the whole-house datum; the solid model floor replaces rendered ground triangles in this bounded passage. Approximate floor and registration, not a surveyed threshold.
